definition: Stiffness describes the resistance of a structural system or member to deformation under applied loading.
physicalMeaning: A stiffer structure generally deforms less when subjected to the same loading.
engineeringImportance: Stiffness controls deformation, load distribution, structural response and stability.
practicalImportance: Engineers consider stiffness when controlling deflection, drift, vibration and the distribution of forces between structural members.
